Disposition.AcceptedUserScope: Current user, launched from non-elevated PowerShell
Disposition.Licensing: No license gate added; package references publisher's GPL-family and bundled component notices

Implementation.Catalog: Adds a pinned, unsupported current-user EXE candidate with exact version, digest, candidate target, product/license references and explicit optional-component booleans.
Implementation.InstallerConfiguration: Writes the declared Boolean map to a unique ASCII INI under a guarded temporary directory, passes the path through one validated argument token, and removes it after success or failure.
Implementation.ConflictPreflight: Blocks unrelated GnuPG registrations and older/different Gpg4win uninstall registrations before the vendor installer can replace them. Permits the nested sibling GnuPG registration only when the matching Gpg4win 5.1.1 current-user registration and install path are present.
Implementation.UserData: Install and removal temporarily move pre-existing %APPDATA%/gnupg data aside while declared GnuPG/Kleopatra processes are stopped, then restore the exact directory. If the package creates a directory at the same path, it is retained under a unique .ride-created name instead of overwriting either tree. The same boundary applies to package restore through the engine's install/remove actions.
